title: The Mandalorian
subtitle: Mandalorian
description: The Mandalorian Din Djarin was a fairly standard, yet incredibly efficient bounty hunter. Accepting pucks, bringing bounties in, and getting paid. After Mando found Grogu his priorities shifted and the altruism inside surfaced. Djarin no longer chased the credit, but fought for the betterment of the galaxy, fighting the Empire, helping settlements in need, and protecting a young Jedi-to-be with his life.
